Kitty - Cross-platform, fast, feature full, GPU based terminal emulator.

summary.one_liner: kitty is a fast, feature-rich, cross-platform, GPU-based terminal emulator.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and mostly consists of links and badges, so little detailed functionality is described. It presents kitty as a terminal for people who work in the terminal, and it is described as fast, feature-rich, cross-platform and GPU-based. It links to a project website, a FAQ, a GitHub discussions or issues area, and a community channel, and it includes a packaging status section for distribution packages. The README does not spell out specific features, configuration options or installation steps in the text provided.
use_cases: running a terminal emulator on desktop
replacing the default system terminal app
notable: Listed as a terminal app in macOS app collections
caveats: README is brief and mostly links; detailed docs are on the external website
Install and run steps are not included in the README text provided
